mechanisms: Repeated official close snapshots permit replay of sector leadership persistence, churn and participation-state transitions without future outcomes.
Leadership identity and participation breadth are distinct state dimensions.
Top-quartile persistence captures sustained leadership candidates while top3 overlap/turnover captures fast rotation.
falsification: Daily leader ranks can be one-day shocks and do not prove persistent economic leadership.
Industry indices can hide member-level concentration and breadth.
Five dates prove data feasibility only, not a stable lifecycle distribution or predictive value.
Sector leadership does not complete individual leader-stock lifecycle evidence.
pitRules: No backdating before official close report capture.
Member explanations require effective-dated membership vintages.
promotionReason: Five independent official TWSE close snapshots across all 34 industry total-return indices clear the prior repeated-PIT-snapshot blocker for the mainstream-sector component of D09-07. Individual-stock leadership and predictive efficacy remain unproven.
